fixedCohort: The four FOCUS_POOLS addresses. Do not silently drop one, add a replacement or tune the set after observing history.
description: A source-derived USD estimate using materially funded, corroborated pool reserves. Not an independent USD oracle, guaranteed stablecoin backing, trade execution quote, TWAP or all-HEX liquidity.
rawSource: Keep every original reserveUSD/derivedUSD/derivedPLS/bundle/quantity token. Separately record a local derived calculation. Stored reserveUSD and contemporary token-price products need not be the same quantity/time; their discrepancy is diagnostic, not a precision gate for this new estimator.
quoteRule: Use exact quote token derivedUSD from its own venue at the same block-pinned read. No symbol-based peg, no replacing a stable-token USD reference with1. Require finite positive well-formed values and supported USD field convention. Compare WPLS derivedUSD with the explicitly described bundle.plsPrice as a diagnostic; do not switch valuation formulas to seek a pass. Missing required input makes that pool unavailable.
pricePerPool: P_i = quote_reserve_i / HEX_reserve_i * quoteUSD_i. Original source HEX derivedUSD is an additional diagnostic/suitability reference, not independent corroboration.

economicEligibility.sameQuantityReserveTolerance: At most one token base unit for subgraph decimal normalization versus paired hash-pinned integer reserves; paired RPC integer/identity replies match exactly.
economicEligibility.qualification: These are new conservative operational inclusion guards, not scientific error bars. Do not tune them from fresh outcomes. The5% suitability guard is not a relaxed version of R1 cached-USD equality.

primaryPrice: Among eligible, fully RPC-checked pools, deterministic descending depthScore then address. Require at least2 eligible pools spanning both V1/V2 and at least2 distinct quote addresses. Every eligible corroborator must agree with selected P within5%; each pool also compares to its venue HEX derivedUSD within5%. Otherwise no qualified price; retain all diagnostics, do not discard outliers merely to obtain agreement.
currentLiquidity: Only when price P qualifies and ALL FOUR focus pools pass current eligibility/identity/reserve/USD checks: L_i = HEX_reserve_i * P + quote_reserve_i * quoteUSD_i; L = sum of four distinct physical pools. Do not substitute stored reserveUSD. Same common P for HEX sides. Include method revision in cohort/generation binding. Missing/rejected constituent -> aggregate null, not a smaller-set sum.
history: Optional second priority. At most90 complete UTC dates before the first new pin date; fixed focus cohort. Use raw pair-day reserves plus actual same-UTC-date token-day USD reference observations for relevant HEX/quote/venue, only after schema/unit/bucket conventions are supported. Apply the same documented primary/depth/valuation arithmetic and coverage gates as historical source-observation estimates, not historic RPC validation or daily closes. All four pools and their required prices must be present on a date; no missing->zero, forward fill, candles->reserves, present prices used backward, unexplained mixing with stored reserveUSD, or cohort shrink. If token-day valuation is unsupported, retain per-pool records but do not publish aggregate history.
historyFamiliesLimit: Four pair-day plus six token-day: V1 HEX/WPLS/DAI; V2 HEX/WPLS/USDC. No other token or benchmark acquisition.
historicalDeclaration: Each historical bucket is composed from within-date source records; their exact intra-day times and common closing time may be unknown. Query block is a retrieval fence, not a measurement date. Document date conventions once. Do not claim point-in-time simultaneity or overwrite existing source rows.
timeAndClosure: Current rounds and their exact pinned closing controls precede optional history. Same fixed cohort, later strictly higher common pin. Seal accepted current observations separately; optional missing history or a known local capability refusal does not erase a successfully sealed current observation. Identity drift/unknown network-accounting integrity still blocks dependent publication. Never publish provisional current values before their controls pass.
product: Keep one HEX price and one trackedLiquidityUsd scalar in existing Daily/Live/Home/CSV. No provider or cohort chooser. Credit/method details once, not per-cell source wrappers. Preserve the300-second existing market freshness threshold; old observations can be retained as stale but not timestamp-refreshed. Do not alter prior HDS reference prices or B0/B1 data.
historicalR1: Remain CLOSED/PARTIAL_NOT_PROMOTABLE with89requests/492852wirebytes and zero updates. Never reinterpret R1 captures under R2 policy as a completed new session.
